<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<base target="_top">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>7 Kebiasaan Anak Indonesia Hebat | SDN 01 Candigaron</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#17324d;--muted:#5d7388;--blue:#0b6bcb;--blue-d:#084f96;--sun:#ffc43d;--leaf:#2fb36d;--coral:#ff6b57;--bg:#f1f7ff;--line:#d9e6f5;--bs-body-font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;--bs-body-color:var(--ink);--bs-primary:var(--blue);--bs-primary-rgb:11,107,203}
body{background:var(--bg);min-height:100vh}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,.brand,.btn-lg{font-family:'Baloo 2',cursive;font-weight:700}
.btn-primary{--bs-btn-bg:var(--blue);--bs-btn-border-color:var(--blue);--bs-btn-hover-bg:var(--blue-d);--bs-btn-hover-border-color:var(--blue-d);--bs-btn-active-bg:var(--blue-d)}
.btn{font-weight:700;border-radius:12px}
.form-control,.form-select{border-radius:12px;border-color:var(--line);padding:.6rem .85rem}
.form-control:focus,.form-select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 .2rem rgba(11,107,203,.15)}
.form-label{font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.topbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:3px solid var(--sun)}
.logo{width:54px;height:54px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sun);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:3px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}.logo img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.brand{line-height:1.1}.brand small{display:block;font-family:'Nunito';font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem}
.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:1.4rem}
.hero{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:2.4rem 2rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sun);opacity:.9}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:90px;bottom:-70px;width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--leaf)}
.hero>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,5vw,3rem);line-height:1.1;max-width:560px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:30px;padding:.3rem .8rem;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;margin:.2rem .15rem 0 0}
.role{display:block;text-align:left;width:100%;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:1.5rem;transition:.15s;color:var(--ink)}
.role:hover{border-color:var(--blue);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.role .ic{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.9rem;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.habit-pills{display:flex;gap:.5rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.4rem}
.hp{flex:0 0 auto;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:.55rem .9rem;font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem}
.hp.on{color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.badge-s{border-radius:20px;padding:.3rem .7rem;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800}
.s-Menunggu{background:#fff3cd;color:#8a6500}.s-Valid{background:#d6f5e3;color:#16744a}.s-Perbaikan{background:#ffe0dc;color:#b3261e}
.note{background:#fff8dc;border-left:5px solid var(--sun);border-radius:12px;padding:.7rem .9rem}
.stat{border-radius:18px;padding:1rem 1.1rem;color:#fff}.stat b{font-family:'Baloo 2';font-size:2rem;line-height:1;display:block}
.table>:not(caption)>*>*{padding:.7rem .6rem;vertical-align:top}
.table thead th{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:2rem 1rem}.empty i{font-size:2.4rem;display:block}
.sig canvas{width:100%;height:150px;border:2px dashed #9fb8d4;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;display:block}
.sigimg{height:46px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;margin-top:2px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem}
.qc{border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:.2rem .75rem;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink)}
.qc:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}.qc.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.input-group .form-control{border-radius:12px 0 0 12px}.input-group .btn{border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--muted);padding:0 .9rem;font-size:1.2rem}
#sigCv{width:100%;aspect-ratio:480/200;touch-action:none;border:2px dashed #9fb8d4;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;display:block;cursor:crosshair}
.sigbox{border:2px dashed #9fb8d4;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;min-height:84px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:.4rem;cursor:pointer}
.view{display:none}.view.on{display:block}
.progress{height:12px;border-radius:10px;background:#e4eef9}
#toasts{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:2000}
/* Modal ubah/tambah catatan: dua kolom & rapat agar muat satu layar tanpa scroll */
#mEntry .modal-header{padding:.7rem 1.1rem}#mEntry .modal-body{padding:.9rem 1.1rem}#mEntry .modal-footer{padding:.6rem 1.1rem}
#mEntry .row{--bs-gutter-y:.6rem}
#mEntry .form-control,#mEntry .form-select{padding:.4rem .75rem}
#mEntry textarea.form-control{min-height:0}
#mEntry .qc{padding:.1rem .6rem;font-size:.8rem}#mEntry .chips{gap:.3rem}#mEntry .chips.mb-2{margin-bottom:.4rem!important}
#mEntry .form-label{margin-bottom:.15rem}
#mEntry .sigbox{min-height:52px}#mEntry .sigbox .sigimg{height:44px!important}
@media(min-width:768px){#tFields>.col-12{width:50%}}
.note.bad{background:#ffe9e6;border-left-color:var(--coral)}
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:4000;background:rgba(23,50,77,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:1rem}
#loader.on{display:flex}
.loadbox{background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:1.7rem 2rem;text-align:center;width:min(100%,300px);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(8,79,150,.35)}
.spin{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:6px solid #dcefff;border-top-color:var(--blue);margin:0 auto .9rem;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.dlg .modal-content{border:0;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(8,79,150,.3)}
.dlg-ic{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:2rem;margin:0 auto 1rem}
.dlg-ic.danger{background:#ffe0dc;color:#b3261e}.dlg-ic.ok{background:#d6f5e3;color:#16744a}.dlg-ic.info{background:#dcefff;color:var(--blue)}.dlg-ic.warn{background:#fff3cd;color:#8a6500}
.dlg .btn{min-width:120px;padding:.55rem 1rem}
@media(max-width:576px){.hero{padding:1.6rem 1.2rem}.panel{padding:1rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.role{transition:none}.spin{animation-duration:2.4s}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="topbar py-2">
  <div class="container d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between">
    <a href="#" class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 text-decoration-none text-reset" onclick="go('vHome');return false">
      <span class="logo"><img alt="Logo Gerakan Tujuh Kebiasaan Anak Indonesia Hebat" src="data:image/png;base64,"></span>
      <span class="brand">7 Kebiasaan Anak Indonesia Hebat<small>SD Negeri 01 Candigaron</small></span>
    </a>
    <div id="topRight"></div>
  </div>
</header>

<main class="container py-4">

<!-- BERANDA -->
<section id="vHome" class="view on">
  <div class="hero mb-4">
    <h1>Catat kebiasaan baikmu setiap hari!</h1>
    <p class="fs-5 mt-2 mb-3" style="max-width:520px">Dari bangun pagi sampai tidur cepat, ayo buktikan kamu anak Indonesia yang hebat.</p>
    <div id="chips"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6">
      <button class="role" onclick="go('vSiswa')">
        <div class="ic" style="background:#dcefff;color:var(--blue)"><i class="bi bi-backpack2-fill"></i></div>
        <h3 class="mb-1">Aku siswa</h3>
        <div class="text-muted">Isi jurnal kebiasaanmu tanpa perlu login. Cukup tulis nama dan kelas.</div>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="col-md-6">
      <button class="role" onclick="go('vLogin')">
        <div class="ic" style="background:#d9f5e6;color:var(--leaf)"><i class="bi bi-person-workspace"></i></div>
        <h3 class="mb-1">Aku guru</h3>
        <div class="text-muted">Masuk dengan username dan sandi untuk memeriksa, memberi komentar, dan mengelola data.</div>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- SISWA -->
<section id="vSiswa" class="view">
  <div id="idCard" class="panel mb-3">
    <h3 class="mb-1">Halo, ceritakan dulu tentang dirimu</h3>
    <p class="text-muted">Kalau kamu sudah pernah mengisi, tulis nama dan kelas yang sama. Data lamamu akan muncul lagi.</p>
    <form id="idForm" class="row g-3">
      <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Nama lengkap</label><input id="p_Nama" class="form-control" required maxlength="80"></div>
      <div class="col-md-3 col-6"><label class="form-label">Kelas</label><input id="p_Kelas" class="form-control" required maxlength="20" placeholder="contoh: 4A"></div>
      <div class="col-md-3 col-6"><label class="form-label">Tanggal lahir</label><input id="p_TglLahir" type="date" class="form-control"></div>
      <div class="col-12"><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" onclick="cekSiswa()"><i class="bi bi-search me-1"></i>Cek nama dan kelas</button><div id="cekMsg" class="mt-2"></div></div>
      <div class="col-md-8"><label class="form-label">Tempat tinggal</label><input id="p_Alamat" class="form-control" maxlength="200" placeholder="Dusun / RT RW / desa"></div>
      <div class="col-md-4"><label class="form-label">Hobi</label><input id="p_Hobi" class="form-control" maxlength="100"></div>
      <div id="idTimes" class="col-12 row g-3 m-0 p-0"></div>
      <div class="col-6 col-md-3"><label class="form-label">Agama</label><select id="p_Agama" class="form-select"></select></div>
      <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Nama orang tua / wali</label><input id="p_NamaOrtu" class="form-control" maxlength="80"></div>
      <div class="col-12 d-flex gap-2"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg px-4">Simpan dan mulai mengisi</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" onclick="go('vHome')">Kembali</button></div>
    </form>
  </div>

  <div id="jArea" style="display:none">
    <div class="panel mb-3 d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center justify-content-between gap-2">
      <div><h4 class="mb-0" id="hi"></h4><div class="text-muted" id="hiSub"></div></div>
      <div class="d-flex gap-2"><button class="btn btn-light" onclick="showId()"><i class="bi bi-pencil me-1"></i>Ubah identitas</button><button class="btn btn-outline-danger" onclick="logoutSiswa()"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-right me-1"></i>Keluar</button></div>
    </div>
    <div id="msgs"></div>
    <div class="habit-pills mb-3" id="pills"></div>
    <div class="row g-3">
      <div class="col-lg-5"><div class="panel">
        <h4 id="fTitle" class="mb-0"></h4><div id="fDesc" class="text-muted mb-3"></div>
        <form id="sForm" class="row g-3">
          <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Tanggal</label><div class="chips mb-2"><button type="button" class="qc" onclick="setTgl(0)">Hari ini</button><button type="button" class="qc" onclick="setTgl(-1)">Kemarin</button><button type="button" class="qc" onclick="setTgl(-2)">2 hari lalu</button></div><input id="s_Tanggal" type="date" class="form-control" required></div>
          <div id="sFields" class="col-12 row g-3 m-0 p-0"></div>
          <div class="col-12"><button class="btn btn-primary w-100 btn-lg">Simpan catatan</button></div>
        </form>
      </div></div>
      <div class="col-lg-7"><div class="panel">
        <div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <h4 class="mb-0">Riwayat bulan ini</h4>
          <input type="month" id="s_Bulan" class="form-control w-auto" onchange="renderList()">
        </div>
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between small fw-bold mb-1"><span id="progTxt"></span></div>
        <div class="progress mb-3"><div id="progBar" class="progress-bar" style="width:0"></div></div>
        <div id="sList"></div>
      </div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- LOGIN GURU -->
<section id="vLogin" class="view">
  <div class="row justify-content-center"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="panel">
      <h3>Masuk sebagai guru</h3>
      <p class="text-muted">Gunakan akun yang diberikan sekolah.</p>
      <form id="loginForm" class="row g-3">
        <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Username</label><input id="l_u" class="form-control" required autocomplete="username"></div>
        <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Sandi</label><div class="input-group"><input id="l_p" type="password" class="form-control" required autocomplete="current-password"><button type="button" id="eyeBtn" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" onclick="togglePw()" aria-label="Tampilkan atau sembunyikan sandi"><i id="eyeIc" class="bi bi-eye-slash"></i></button></div></div>
        <div class="col-12 d-flex gap-2"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg px-4">Masuk</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" onclick="go('vHome')">Kembali</button></div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div></div>
</section>

<!-- DASHBOARD GURU -->
<section id="vGuru" class="view">
  <div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 mb-3"><h3 class="mb-0">Dashboard guru</h3><div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAkun()"><i class="bi bi-person-plus-fill me-1"></i>Tambah akun guru</button><button class="btn btn-outline-danger" onclick="logout()"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-right me-1"></i>Keluar</button></div></div>
  <div class="row g-3 mb-3" id="stats"></div>
  <ul class="nav nav-pills mb-3 gap-1">
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link active" data-bs-toggle="pill" data-bs-target="#tJurnal"><i class="bi bi-journal-check me-1"></i>Jurnal siswa</button></li>
    <li class="nav-item"><button class="nav-link" data-bs-toggle="pill" data-bs-target="#tSiswa"><i class="bi bi-people me-1"></i>Data siswa</button></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="tab-content">
    <div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="tJurnal">
      <div class="panel mb-3">
        <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
          <div class="col-6 col-md-2"><label class="form-label">Bulan</label><input type="month" id="f_bulan" class="form-control" onchange="renderT()"></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-2"><label class="form-label">Kelas</label><select id="f_kelas" class="form-select" onchange="renderT()"></select></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-3"><label class="form-label">Kebiasaan</label><select id="f_kebiasaan" class="form-select" onchange="renderT()"></select></div>
          <div class="col-6 col-md-2"><label class="form-label">Status</label>
            <select id="f_status" class="form-select" onchange="renderT()"><option value="">Semua</option><option>Menunggu</option><option>Valid</option><option>Perlu Perbaikan</option></select></div>
          <div class="col-8 col-md-2"><label class="form-label">Cari nama</label><input id="f_cari" class="form-control" oninput="renderT()" placeholder="Nama siswa"></div>
          <div class="col-4 col-md-1 d-grid"><button class="btn btn-light" onclick="resetF()" title="Atur ulang"><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i></button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">
          <h4 class="mb-0">Catatan kebiasaan <span class="text-muted fs-6" id="cnt"></span></h4>
          <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openEntry()"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg me-1"></i>Tambah catatan</button>
        </div>
        <div class="table-responsive"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Siswa</th><th>Kebiasaan</th><th>Isi catatan</th><th>Status</th><th class="text-end">Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody id="tBody"></tbody></table></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-pane fade" id="tSiswa"><div class="panel">
      <h4 class="mb-3">Data siswa <span class="text-muted fs-6" id="cntS"></span></h4>
      <div class="row g-2 align-items-end mb-3">
        <div class="col-12 col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Cari siswa</label><input id="fs_cari" class="form-control" oninput="renderSiswa()" placeholder="Nama siswa, orang tua, atau tempat tinggal"></div>
        <div class="col-8 col-md-4"><label class="form-label">Kelas</label><select id="fs_kelas" class="form-select" onchange="renderSiswa()"></select></div>
        <div class="col-4 col-md-2 d-grid"><button class="btn btn-light" onclick="resetS()" title="Atur ulang"><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i></button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="table-responsive"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Nama</th><th>Kelas</th><th>Tanggal lahir</th><th>Tinggal / hobi</th><th>Rutinitas</th><th>Orang tua</th><th>Catatan</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="sBody"></tbody></table></div>
    </div></div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<!-- Modal tambah/ubah -->
<div class="modal fade" id="mEntry" tabindex="-1"><div class="modal-dialog modal-xl"><div class="modal-content" style="border-radius:20px">
  <form id="tForm">
  <div class="modal-header"><h4 class="modal-title" id="mEntryT"></h4><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button></div>
  <div class="modal-body"><div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Nama siswa</label><input id="t_Nama" list="dlNama" class="form-control" required></div>
    <datalist id="dlNama"></datalist>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Kelas</label><input id="t_Kelas" class="form-control" required></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Kebiasaan</label><select id="t_Kebiasaan" class="form-select" onchange="tFields()"></select></div>
    <div class="col-md-6"><label class="form-label">Tanggal</label><input id="t_Tanggal" type="date" class="form-control" required></div>
    <div id="tFields" class="col-12 row g-3 m-0 p-0"></div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="modal-footer"><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-primary">Simpan</button></div>
  </form>
</div></div></div>

<!-- Modal validasi -->
<div class="modal fade" id="mRev" tabindex="-1"><div class="modal-dialog"><div class="modal-content" style="border-radius:20px">
  <form id="rForm">
  <div class="modal-header"><h4 class="modal-title">Periksa dan beri komentar</h4><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button></div>
  <div class="modal-body">
    <div class="note mb-3" id="rInfo"></div>
    <label class="form-label">Status</label>
    <select id="r_Status" class="form-select mb-3"><option>Menunggu</option><option>Valid</option><option>Perlu Perbaikan</option></select>
    <label class="form-label">Komentar untuk siswa</label>
    <textarea id="r_Komentar" rows="3" maxlength="500" class="form-control" placeholder="Contoh: Hebat, pertahankan ya! atau Jamnya belum diisi, tolong dilengkapi."></textarea>
  </div>
  <div class="modal-footer"><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-primary">Simpan penilaian</button></div>
  </form>
</div></div></div>

<!-- Modal tambah akun guru -->
<div class="modal fade" id="mAkun" tabindex="-1"><div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered"><div class="modal-content" style="border-radius:20px">
  <form id="aForm" autocomplete="off">
  <div class="modal-header"><h4 class="modal-title"><i class="bi bi-person-plus-fill me-2 text-primary"></i>Tambah akun guru</h4><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button></div>
  <div class="modal-body"><div class="row g-3">
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Nama guru</label><input id="a_Nama" class="form-control" required maxlength="60" placeholder="contoh: Bu Rina, S.Pd."></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Username</label><input id="a_User" class="form-control" required maxlength="30" pattern="[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{3,30}" title="3-30 karakter: huruf, angka, titik, garis bawah, atau strip. Tanpa spasi." autocapitalize="none" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"><div class="form-text">3-30 karakter: huruf, angka, titik, garis bawah, atau strip. Tanpa spasi.</div></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Sandi</label><div class="input-group"><input id="a_P" type="password" class="form-control" required minlength="6" maxlength="50" autocomplete="new-password"><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" onclick="togglePwAkun()" aria-label="Tampilkan atau sembunyikan sandi"><i id="eyeAk" class="bi bi-eye-slash"></i></button></div><div class="form-text">Minimal 6 karakter.</div></div>
    <div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">Ulangi sandi</label><input id="a_P2" type="password" class="form-control" required minlength="6" maxlength="50" autocomplete="new-password"></div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="modal-footer"><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-primary"><i class="bi bi-check-lg me-1"></i>Buat akun</button></div>
  </form>
</div></div></div>

<!-- Panel konfirmasi -->
<div class="modal fade dlg" id="mAsk" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="askT"><div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered" style="max-width:430px"><div class="modal-content"><div class="modal-body text-center p-4">
  <div id="askIc" class="dlg-ic info"></div>
  <h4 id="askT" class="mb-2"></h4>
  <p id="askD" class="text-muted mb-3"></p>
  <div id="askX" class="note text-start small mb-3" style="display:none"></div>
  <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-content-center"><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" id="askNo">Batal</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="askYes">Ya</button></div>
</div></div></div></div>

<!-- Layar loading -->
<div id="loader" role="alert" aria-live="assertive"><div class="loadbox"><div class="spin"></div><h5 id="loadT" class="mb-1">Memproses...</h5><div id="loadS" class="small text-muted">Mohon tunggu sebentar</div></div></div>

<div id="sigOv" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3000;background:rgba(23,50,77,.65);padding:12px;overflow:auto">
  <div class="panel mx-auto mt-3" style="max-width:560px">
    <h5 class="mb-2">Tanda tangan di dalam kotak</h5>
    <canvas id="sigCv" width="480" height="200"></canvas>
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3"><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" onclick="sigCancel()">Batal</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-light" onclick="sigBlank()"><i class="bi bi-eraser me-1"></i>Hapus</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-primary ms-auto" onclick="sigSave()">Simpan tanda tangan</button></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="toasts"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ===== Konfigurasi kebiasaan ===== */
const R=(a,b,s=30)=>{const o=[];for(let m=a*60;m<=b*60;m+=s)o.push(String(Math.floor(m/60)).padStart(2,'0')+'.'+String(m%60).padStart(2,'0'));return o};
const TP='([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3])[.:]?[0-5][0-9]';
const AGAMA=['Islam','Kristen','Katolik','Hindu','Buddha','Konghucu'];
const IB={Islam:['Subuh','Dzuhur','Ashar','Maghrib','Isya','Dhuha','Tahajud','Mengaji'],Kristen:['Doa pagi','Doa malam','Baca Alkitab','Ibadah Minggu'],Katolik:['Doa pagi','Doa malam','Doa Rosario','Misa'],Hindu:['Puja Tri Sandhya','Sembahyang','Baca Weda'],Buddha:['Puja bakti','Meditasi','Paritta'],Konghucu:['Sembahyang','Doa pagi','Doa malam']};
const FEEL=['Senang','Bangga','Semangat','Biasa saja','Capek','Sedih'];
const PT=['Ayah','Ibu','Wali'],PK=['Guru','Ketua RT','Ketua RW','Pembina','Ketua kelas'];
/* field: [kolom, label, tipe, pilihan cepat, mode('add' = bisa pilih banyak)] */
const H={
 'Bangun Pagi':{ic:'brightness-alt-high-fill',c:'#f59f00',d:'Melatih disiplin dan menghargai waktu.',f:[['JamMulai','Jam bangun','time',R(2,7)],['Paraf','Tanda tangan orang tua','text']]},
 'Beribadah':{ic:'moon-stars-fill',c:'#7048e8',d:'Ibadah jadi dasar kejujuran dan akhlak baik.',f:[['Detail1','Agama','agama'],['Detail2','Ibadah hari ini & jamnya','ibadahjam'],['Paraf','Tanda tangan orang tua','text']]},
 'Berolahraga':{ic:'bicycle',c:'#e8590c',d:'Badan sehat, hati senang, belajar sportif.',f:[['JamMulai','Jam mulai','time',R(5,7).concat(R(15,17))],['JamSelesai','Jam selesai','time',R(6,8).concat(R(16,18))],['Detail1','Olahraga yang dilakukan','text',['Lari','Jalan pagi','Bersepeda','Senam','Sepak bola','Bulu tangkis','Voli','Renang']]]},
 'Makan Sehat & Bergizi':{ic:'egg-fried',c:'#2f9e44',d:'Makan seimbang, kurangi makanan instan.',f:[['Detail1','Menu makan sehat hari ini','area',['Nasi','Sayur','Ikan','Telur','Tempe','Tahu','Ayam','Buah','Susu','Air putih'],'add']]},
 'Gemar Belajar':{ic:'book-half',c:'#0b6bcb',d:'Rasa ingin tahu, rajin membaca, kreatif.',f:[['Detail1','Buku yang dipelajari','text',['Buku pelajaran','Buku cerita','Komik edukasi','Ensiklopedia','Majalah anak']],['Detail2','Informasi yang didapat','area']]},
 'Bermasyarakat':{ic:'people-fill',c:'#d6336c',d:'Peduli, kerja sama, dan gotong royong.',f:[['Detail1','Kegiatan yang diikuti','text',['Kerja bakti','Membantu tetangga','Bersih lingkungan','Kegiatan keagamaan','Gotong royong']],['Detail2','Perasaanku','text',FEEL],['Paraf','Tanda tangan ketua kegiatan','text']]},
 'Tidur Cepat':{ic:'moon-fill',c:'#1c7ed6',d:'Istirahat cukup supaya tubuh segar kembali.',f:[['JamMulai','Jam mulai tidur','time',R(19,23)],['JamSelesai','Jam bangun tidur','time',R(3,6)]]}
};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const iso=d=>d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
const today=()=>iso(new Date());
const fmtD=s=>{if(!s)return'-';const[y,m,d]=s.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d).toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{weekday:'short',day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'})};
const api=(fn,...a)=>new Promise((ok,no)=>google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(ok).withFailureHandler(e=>no(e))[fn](...a));
function toast(msg,bad){const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='toast show align-items-center text-white border-0 mb-2 '+(bad?'bg-danger':'bg-success');e.innerHTML='<div class="d-flex"><div class="toast-body fw-bold">'+esc(msg)+'</div></div>';$('toasts').appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),3800)}
/* Layar loading: muncul otomatis selama proses ke server (ditunda 120 ms agar tidak berkedip) */
let busy=0,loadTm=null;
function loadOn(t,sub){busy++;if(busy>1)return;$('loadT').textContent=t||'Memproses...';$('loadS').textContent=sub||'Mohon tunggu sebentar';loadTm=setTimeout(()=>$('loader').classList.add('on'),120)}
function loadOff(){busy=Math.max(0,busy-1);if(busy)return;clearTimeout(loadTm);$('loader').classList.remove('on')}
async function run(btn,fn,msg,sub){if(btn)btn.disabled=true;loadOn(msg,sub);try{return await fn()}catch(e){toast((e.message||String(e)).replace(/^Error:\s*/,''),true)}finally{loadOff();if(btn)btn.disabled=false}}
/* Panel konfirmasi pengganti confirm(). Contoh: if(!await ask({tone:'danger',title:'...',text:'...'}))return */
const mA=new bootstrap.Modal($('mAsk'));let askRes=null;
function ask(o){return new Promise(res=>{
  $('askIc').className='dlg-ic '+(o.tone||'info');$('askIc').innerHTML='<i class="bi bi-'+(o.icon||'question-lg')+'"></i>';
  $('askT').textContent=o.title;$('askD').innerHTML=o.text||'';
  const x=$('askX');x.style.display=o.extra?'block':'none';x.innerHTML=o.extra||'';x.className='note text-start small mb-3'+(o.tone==='danger'?' bad':'');
  const y=$('askYes');y.textContent=o.ok||'Ya';y.className='btn '+({danger:'btn-danger',ok:'btn-success',warn:'btn-warning'}[o.tone]||'btn-primary');
  askRes=res;mA.show()})}
function askEnd(v){const r=askRes;askRes=null;if(r)r(v);mA.hide()}
$('askYes').onclick=()=>askEnd(true);$('askNo').onclick=()=>askEnd(false);
$('mAsk').addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{if(askRes){const r=askRes;askRes=null;r(false)}});
const sbtn=ev=>ev.target.querySelector('button:not([type=button])');
function go(v){document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));$(v).classList.add('on');window.scrollTo(0,0);
  $('topRight').innerHTML=v==='vGuru'?'<button class="btn btn-light btn-sm" onclick="logout()"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-right me-1"></i>Keluar ('+esc(T.nama)+')</button>':''}

/* ===== Form dinamis ===== */
const chipsHTML=(id,opts,mode)=>`<div class="chips mb-2" data-for="${id}" data-mode="${mode||'set'}">${(opts||[]).map(o=>`<button type="button" class="qc">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
function fieldsHTML(h,pre,v={}){return H[h].f.map(([k,l,t,opts,mode])=>{
  const id=pre+k,val=esc((t==='time'?String(v[k]||'').replace(':','.'):v[k])||''),req=k==='Paraf'?'':'required';let inp;
  if(k==='Paraf')inp=`<div class="sig"><input type="hidden" id="${id}" value="${val}"><div id="${id}_p" class="sigbox" onclick="sigOpen('${id}')">${sigPrev(v[k])}</div><div class="d-flex gap-2 mt-2"><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="sigOpen('${id}')"><i class="bi bi-pen me-1"></i>Tanda tangan</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-light" onclick="sigClear('${id}')">Hapus</button></div></div>`;
  else if(t==='area')inp=`<textarea id="${id}" rows="2" maxlength="500" class="form-control" placeholder="Pilih di atas atau ketik sendiri" ${req}>${val}</textarea>`;
  else if(t==='ibadahjam')inp=ibJamHTML(id,v[k],v.Detail1);
  else if(t==='agama')inp=`<select id="${id}" class="form-select" onchange="updDl('${pre}')" ${req}>${AGAMA.map(a=>`<option ${a===v[k]?'selected':''}>${a}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
  else if(t==='time')inp=`<input id="${id}" class="form-control" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" pattern="${TP}" title="Tulis jam, contoh 04.15" maxlength="5" placeholder="Pilih jam atau ketik, mis. 04.15" value="${val}" ${req}>`;
  else inp=`<input id="${id}" class="form-control" maxlength="${k==='Paraf'?80:100}" autocomplete="off" placeholder="${opts||t==='ibadah'?'Pilih di atas atau ketik sendiri':''}" value="${val}" ${req}>`;
  const ch=(opts||t==='ibadah')?chipsHTML(id,opts,mode):'';
  return `<div class="col-12"><label class="form-label">${l}</label>${ch}${inp}</div>`}).join('')}
const IBJ={Subuh:['04.15','04.30','04.45','05.00'],Dzuhur:['11.45','12.00','12.15','12.30'],Ashar:['15.00','15.15','15.30','15.45'],Maghrib:['17.45','18.00','18.15','18.30'],Isya:['19.00','19.15','19.30','20.00'],Dhuha:['06.30','07.00','08.00','09.00'],Tahajud:['02.00','03.00','03.30','04.00'],Mengaji:['16.00','17.00','18.30','19.30'],
 'Doa pagi':['05.30','06.00','06.30','07.00'],'Doa malam':['19.00','20.00','21.00'],'Baca Alkitab':['18.00','19.00','20.00'],'Ibadah Minggu':['07.00','08.00','09.00','10.00'],'Doa Rosario':['18.00','19.00','20.00'],'Misa':['06.00','07.00','17.00','18.00'],
 'Puja Tri Sandhya':['06.00','12.00','18.00'],'Sembahyang':['06.00','12.00','18.00'],'Baca Weda':['18.30','19.30'],'Puja bakti':['06.00','18.00','19.00'],'Meditasi':['05.30','06.00','19.00','20.00'],'Paritta':['06.00','18.00','19.00']};
function ibMap(s){const m={};String(s||'').split(/,\s*/).forEach(p=>{const r=/^(.*?)\s+(\d{1,2})[.:](\d{2})$/.exec(p.trim());if(r)m[r[1]]=r[2].padStart(2,'0')+'.'+r[3]});return m}
function ibRows(ag,val){const m=ibMap(val);return (IB[ag]||[]).map(n=>`<div class="ibr mb-3"><label class="fw-bold small">${esc(n)}</label><div class="chips mb-1">${(IBJ[n]||[]).map(t=>`<button type="button" class="qc${m[n]===t?' on':''}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div><input type="text" class="form-control ibt" data-n="${esc(n)}" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" maxlength="5" placeholder="Pilih jam atau ketik, mis. 04.30" value="${m[n]||''}"></div>`).join('')}
function ibJamHTML(id,val,ag){ag=ag||'Islam';return `<div class="text-muted small mb-2">Isi jam untuk ibadah yang kamu lakukan hari ini. Yang tidak dilakukan, kosongkan saja.</div><div id="${id}_w" data-ag="${esc(ag)}">${ibRows(ag,val)}</div><input type="hidden" id="${id}" value="${esc(val||'')}">`}
function ibSync(w){const v=[];w.querySelectorAll('.ibr').forEach(r=>{const i=r.querySelector('.ibt'),t=i.value.trim(),m=/^(\d{1,2})[.:]?(\d{2})$/.exec(t),ok=!!m&&+m[1]<24&&+m[2]<60,n=ok?m[1].padStart(2,'0')+'.'+m[2]:'';
  i.classList.toggle('is-invalid',!!t&&!ok);if(ok)v.push(i.dataset.n+' '+n);
  r.querySelectorAll('.qc').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x.textContent===n))});
  $(w.id.replace(/_w$/,'')).value=v.join(', ')}
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{const t=e.target;if(t.classList&&t.classList.contains('ibt')){const w=t.closest('[data-ag]');if(w)ibSync(w)}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.ibr .qc');if(!b)return;const i=b.closest('.ibr').querySelector('.ibt');i.value=i.value.trim()===b.textContent?'':b.textContent;ibSync(b.closest('[data-ag]'))});
function updDl(pre){const a=$(pre+'Detail1'),w=$(pre+'Detail2_w');
  if(a&&w&&w.dataset.ag!==a.value){w.dataset.ag=a.value;w.innerHTML=ibRows(a.value,'');$(pre+'Detail2').value=''}}
const sigPrev=v=>v&&String(v).startsWith('data:image')?`<img class="sigimg" style="height:70px" alt="Tanda tangan" src="${v}">`:'<span class="text-muted small">Belum ada tanda tangan. Ketuk di sini untuk menandatangani.</span>';
let sigTarget=null,sigD=false,sigInk=false;
const sigC=()=>$('sigCv'),sigX=()=>sigC().getContext('2d');
function sigBlank(){const x=sigX(),c=sigC();x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);x.lineWidth=3.5;x.lineCap='round';x.lineJoin='round';x.strokeStyle='#17324d';sigInk=false}
function sigOpen(id){sigTarget=id;sigBlank();const v=$(id).value;
  if(v.startsWith('data:image')){const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{sigX().drawImage(im,0,0,sigC().width,sigC().height);sigInk=true};im.src=v}
  $('sigOv').style.display='block'}
function sigCancel(){$('sigOv').style.display='none'}
function sigSave(){$(sigTarget).value=sigInk?sigC().toDataURL('image/jpeg',.6):'';$(sigTarget+'_p').innerHTML=sigPrev($(sigTarget).value);sigCancel()}
function sigClear(id){$(id).value='';$(id+'_p').innerHTML=sigPrev('')}
(function(){const c=sigC(),pt=e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();return[(e.clientX-r.left)*c.width/r.width,(e.clientY-r.top)*c.height/r.height]};
  c.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();sigD=true;c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);const[x,y]=pt(e),g=sigX();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y);g.lineTo(x+.1,y+.1);g.stroke();sigInk=true};
  c.onpointermove=e=>{if(!sigD)return;e.preventDefault();const[x,y]=pt(e),g=sigX();g.lineTo(x,y);g.stroke()};
  c.onpointerup=c.onpointercancel=()=>{sigD=false}})();
const nt=s=>{const m=/^(\d{1,2})[.:]?(\d{2})$/.exec(String(s).trim());return m?m[1].padStart(2,'0')+':'+m[2]:String(s).trim()};
function getVals(h,pre){const o={};H[h].f.forEach(([k,,t])=>{const v=$(pre+k).value.trim();o[k]=t==='time'?nt(v):v});return o}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.qc');if(!b)return;const c=b.parentElement,i=c.dataset.for&&$(c.dataset.for);if(!i)return;
  if(c.dataset.mode==='add'){const p=i.value?i.value.split(/,\s*/).filter(Boolean):[],t=b.textContent,x=p.indexOf(t);x>=0?p.splice(x,1):p.push(t);i.value=p.join(', ')}else i.value=b.textContent;
  i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{const i=e.target;if(!i.id)return;const c=document.querySelector('.chips[data-for="'+i.id+'"]');if(!c)return;
  const p=c.dataset.mode==='add'?i.value.split(/,\s*/):[i.value];c.querySelectorAll('.qc').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',p.includes(b.textContent)))});
function detail(e){return detail0(e)+(e.Kebiasaan==='Beribadah'&&e.JamMulai?`<div><span class="text-muted">Jam beribadah:</span> ${esc(e.JamMulai)}</div>`:'')}
function detail0(e){const f=H[e.Kebiasaan]?.f||[];return f.map(([k,l])=>e[k]?(k==='Paraf'&&e[k].startsWith('data:image')?`<div><span class="text-muted">${l}:</span><br><img class="sigimg" alt="Tanda tangan" src="${e[k]}"></div>`:`<div><span class="text-muted">${l}:</span> ${esc(e[k])}</div>`):'').join('')}
const badge=s=>`<span class="badge-s s-${s==='Perlu Perbaikan'?'Perbaikan':s}">${esc(s)}</span>`;
const chipHabit=h=>`<span class="badge rounded-pill" style="background:${H[h].c}"><i class="bi bi-${H[h].ic} me-1"></i>${esc(h)}</span>`;

/* ===== Beranda ===== */
$('chips').innerHTML=Object.keys(H).map(h=>`<span class="chip"><i class="bi bi-${H[h].ic}"></i>${h}</span>`).join('');
$('idTimes').innerHTML=[['JamTidur','Biasa tidur jam',R(19,23)],['JamBangun','Biasa bangun jam',R(3,6)],['JamIbadah','Biasa beribadah jam',['04.30','05.00','12.00','15.00','18.00','19.00']]].map(([k,l,o])=>`<div class="col-12 col-md-4"><label class="form-label">${l}</label>${chipsHTML('p_'+k,o)}<input id="p_${k}" class="form-control" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" pattern="${TP}" title="Tulis jam, contoh 04.15" maxlength="5" placeholder="Pilih jam atau ketik, mis. 21.00"></div>`).join('');
$('p_Agama').innerHTML=AGAMA.map(a=>`<option>${a}</option>`).join('');

/* ===== SISWA ===== */
const S={profile:null,entries:[],habit:'Bangun Pagi'};
const getSaved=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kb_id')||'null')}catch(e){return null}};
function enterJournal(r){S.profile=r.profile;S.entries=r.entries;$('idCard').style.display='none';$('jArea').style.display='block';
  $('hi').textContent='Halo, '+S.profile.Nama+'!';$('hiSub').textContent='Kelas '+S.profile.Kelas;$('s_Bulan').value=today().slice(0,7);pickHabit(S.habit)}
function fillForm(p){['Nama','Kelas','TglLahir','Alamat','Hobi','JamTidur','JamBangun','JamIbadah','Agama','NamaOrtu'].forEach(x=>{if(p[x])$('p_'+x).value=p[x]})}
/* Siswa yang pernah masuk di perangkat ini langsung dilanjutkan */
function resumeSiswa(){const k=getSaved();if(!k)return;
  api('siswaLanjut',k.n,k.k).then(r=>{if(r){fillForm(r.profile);enterJournal(r);go('vSiswa');toast('Selamat datang kembali, '+r.profile.Nama+'!')}}).catch(()=>{})}
function cekSiswa(){const n=$('p_Nama').value.trim(),k=$('p_Kelas').value.trim(),m=$('cekMsg');
  if(!n||!k){m.innerHTML='<div class="note">Isi nama dan kelas dulu ya.</div>';return}
  m.innerHTML='<span class="text-muted">Mencari data...</span>';
  api('siswaLanjut',n,k).then(r=>{
    if(!r){window._found=null;m.innerHTML='<div class="note">Belum ada data atas nama <b>'+esc(n)+'</b> kelas '+esc(k)+'. Lengkapi identitas di bawah, lalu tekan Simpan.</div>';return}
    window._found=r;fillForm(r.profile);
    m.innerHTML='<div class="note d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2"><span><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success me-1"></i>Data <b>'+esc(r.profile.Nama)+'</b> kelas '+esc(r.profile.Kelas)+' ditemukan ('+r.entries.length+' catatan).</span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="lanjutFound()">Lanjut ke jurnal</button></div>'
  }).catch(e=>{m.innerHTML='';toast((e.message||'Gagal mencari data').replace(/^Error:\s*/,''),true)})}
function lanjutFound(){const r=window._found;if(!r)return;try{localStorage.setItem('kb_id',JSON.stringify({n:r.profile.Nama,k:r.profile.Kelas}))}catch(e){}enterJournal(r);toast('Selamat datang kembali, '+r.profile.Nama+'!')}
function logoutSiswa(){$('cekMsg').innerHTML='';window._found=null;try{localStorage.removeItem('kb_id')}catch(e){}
  S.profile=null;S.entries=[];$('idForm').reset();$('jArea').style.display='none';$('idCard').style.display='block';go('vHome');toast('Kamu sudah keluar')}
resumeSiswa();
async function autofill(){const n=$('p_Nama').value.trim(),k=$('p_Kelas').value.trim();if(!n||!k||$('p_Hobi').value||$('p_Alamat').value)return;
  try{const p=await api('siswaCari',n,k);if(p){['TglLahir','Alamat','Hobi','JamTidur','JamBangun','JamIbadah','Agama','NamaOrtu'].forEach(x=>{if(p[x])$('p_'+x).value=p[x]});toast('Profilmu ditemukan, tinggal dicek lagi ya')}}catch(e){}}
$('idForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();const o={};['Nama','Kelas','TglLahir','Alamat','Hobi','JamTidur','JamBangun','JamIbadah','Agama','NamaOrtu'].forEach(k=>o[k]=$('p_'+k).value.trim());
  ['JamTidur','JamBangun','JamIbadah'].forEach(k=>o[k]=o[k]?nt(o[k]):'');
  run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{const r=await api('siswaMasuk',o);
    try{localStorage.setItem('kb_id',JSON.stringify({n:o.Nama,k:o.Kelas}))}catch(e){}
    enterJournal(r);toast('Identitas tersimpan')},'Menyimpan identitas...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')};
function setTgl(n){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);$('s_Tanggal').value=iso(d)}
function showId(){$('idCard').style.display='block';$('jArea').style.display='none'}
function pickHabit(h){S.habit=h;
  $('pills').innerHTML=Object.keys(H).map(k=>`<button class="hp ${k===h?'on':''}" style="${k===h?'background:'+H[k].c:''}" onclick="pickHabit('${k}')"><i class="bi bi-${H[k].ic}"></i>${k}</button>`).join('');
  $('fTitle').innerHTML=`<i class="bi bi-${H[h].ic} me-1" style="color:${H[h].c}"></i>${h}`;$('fDesc').textContent=H[h].d;
  $('s_Tanggal').value=today();$('sFields').innerHTML=fieldsHTML(h,'s_',{Detail1:H[h].f.some(f=>f[2]==='agama')?S.profile.Agama:'',JamMulai:''});
  if(h==='Beribadah'){$('s_Detail1').value=S.profile.Agama||'Islam';updDl('s_')}
  if(h==='Bangun Pagi'&&S.profile.JamBangun)$('s_JamMulai').value=S.profile.JamBangun;
  if(h==='Tidur Cepat'&&S.profile.JamTidur)$('s_JamMulai').value=S.profile.JamTidur;
  renderMsgs();renderList()}
$('sForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();const h=S.habit;
  const e={Nama:S.profile.Nama,Kelas:S.profile.Kelas,Kebiasaan:h,Tanggal:$('s_Tanggal').value,...getVals(h,'s_')};
  if(h==='Beribadah'&&document.querySelector('#sFields .ibt.is-invalid')){toast('Ada jam yang formatnya salah, contoh yang benar 04.30',true);return}
  if(h==='Beribadah'&&!e.Detail2){toast('Isi minimal satu ibadah beserta jamnya',true);return}
  run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{S.entries=await api('siswaSimpanJurnal',e);$('s_Bulan').value=e.Tanggal.slice(0,7);pickHabit(S.habit);$('s_Tanggal').value=e.Tanggal;toast('Catatan tersimpan. Hebat!')},'Menyimpan catatan...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')};
/* Pesan guru yang sudah dibaca disembunyikan (disimpan di perangkat siswa; komentar baru/diubah guru muncul lagi) */
const msgKey=e=>e.ID+'|'+(e.TglKomentar||'');
function disSet(){try{return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kb_dis')||'[]'))}catch(x){return new Set()}}
function disSave(st){try{localStorage.setItem('kb_dis',JSON.stringify([...st].slice(-300)))}catch(x){}}
function dismissMsg(id){const e=S.entries.find(x=>x.ID===id);if(!e)return;const st=disSet();st.add(msgKey(e));disSave(st);renderMsgs()}
function dismissAll(){const st=disSet();S.entries.filter(e=>e.KomentarGuru).forEach(e=>st.add(msgKey(e)));disSave(st);renderMsgs()}
function toggleRead(id){const e=S.entries.find(x=>x.ID===id);if(!e)return;const st=disSet(),k=msgKey(e);st.has(k)?st.delete(k):st.add(k);disSave(st);renderMsgs()}
const msgWaktu=e=>{const t=e.TglKomentar||'';return t?fmtD(t.slice(0,10))+(t.length>=16?', '+t.slice(11,16):''):fmtD(e.Tanggal)};
function allMsgs(){return S.entries.filter(e=>e.KomentarGuru).sort((a,b)=>(b.TglKomentar||b.Tanggal).localeCompare(a.TglKomentar||a.Tanggal))}
function renderMsgs(){const st=disSet(),all=allMsgs(),un=all.filter(e=>!st.has(msgKey(e))),m=un.slice(0,3);
  $('msgs').innerHTML=all.length?`<div class="panel mb-3"><div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 mb-2"><h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-chat-heart-fill text-danger me-1"></i>Pesan dari guru</h5><div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2"><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-light" onclick="openInbox()"><i class="bi bi-inbox me-1"></i>Semua pesan (${all.length})</button>${un.length>1?`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-light" onclick="dismissAll()"><i class="bi bi-check2-all me-1"></i>Sudah dibaca semua</button>`:''}</div></div>${m.length?m.map(e=>`<div class="note mb-2"><div class="small text-muted">${esc(e.Kebiasaan)} - ${fmtD(e.Tanggal)} - ${esc(e.Validator||'Guru')}</div>${esc(e.KomentarGuru)}<div class="text-end mt-1"><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" onclick="dismissMsg('${e.ID}')"><i class="bi bi-check-lg me-1"></i>Sudah dibaca</button></div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="text-muted small">Tidak ada pesan baru. Pesan yang sudah dibaca masih tersimpan di <b>Semua pesan</b>.</div>'}${un.length>3?`<div class="small text-muted">+ ${un.length-3} pesan baru lainnya ada di Semua pesan.</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
  if($('inboxBody'))renderInbox()}
/* Kotak pesan: semua komentar guru, termasuk yang sudah dibaca */
let mInbox=null;
function openInbox(){if(!mInbox){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='modal fade';d.id='mInbox';d.tabIndex=-1;
  d.innerHTML='<div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-scrollable modal-dialog-centered"><div class="modal-content"><div class="modal-header"><h5 class="modal-title"><i class="bi bi-inbox-fill text-danger me-2"></i>Kotak pesan dari guru</h5><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Tutup"></button></div><div class="modal-body" id="inboxBody"></div></div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(d);mInbox=new bootstrap.Modal(d)}
  renderInbox();mInbox.show()}
function renderInbox(){const st=disSet(),all=allMsgs();
  $('inboxBody').innerHTML=all.length?all.map(e=>{const r=st.has(msgKey(e));
    return `<div class="border rounded-4 p-3 mb-2" style="${r?'':'background:#fff8e1;border-color:#f6c445!important'}"><div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-1 mb-1">${chipHabit(e.Kebiasaan)}<span>${r?'<span class="badge text-bg-light">Sudah dibaca</span>':'<span class="badge text-bg-warning">Baru</span>'}</span></div>
      <div class="small text-muted mb-1">Catatan ${fmtD(e.Tanggal)} - ${esc(e.Validator||'Guru')} - ${msgWaktu(e)}</div><div class="mb-2">${esc(e.KomentarGuru)}</div>
      <div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2">${badge(e.Status)}<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm ${r?'btn-outline-secondary':'btn-outline-success'}" onclick="toggleRead('${e.ID}')">${r?'<i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise me-1"></i>Tandai belum dibaca':'<i class="bi bi-check-lg me-1"></i>Sudah dibaca'}</button></div></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="empty"><i class="bi bi-inbox"></i>Belum ada pesan dari guru.</div>'}
function renderList(){const b=$('s_Bulan').value||today().slice(0,7),h=S.habit;
  const l=S.entries.filter(e=>e.Kebiasaan===h&&e.Tanggal.startsWith(b));
  const [y,m]=b.split('-').map(Number),dim=new Date(y,m,0).getDate(),days=new Set(l.map(e=>e.Tanggal)).size;
  $('progTxt').textContent=`${days} dari ${dim} hari terisi`;$('progBar').style.width=(days/dim*100)+'%';$('progBar').style.background=H[h].c;
  $('sList').innerHTML=l.length?l.map(e=>`<div class="border rounded-4 p-3 mb-2"><div class="d-flex justify-content-between gap-2"><b>${fmtD(e.Tanggal)}</b><div>${badge(e.Status)}${e.Status==='Menunggu'?` <button class="btn btn-sm text-danger p-0 ms-1" onclick="delS('${e.ID}')" title="Hapus"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>`:''}</div></div>${detail(e)}${e.KomentarGuru?`<div class="note mt-2 small"><b>${esc(e.Validator||'Guru')}:</b> ${esc(e.KomentarGuru)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i>Belum ada catatan di bulan ini. Yuk isi dari formulir di samping.</div>'}
async function delS(id){const e=S.entries.find(x=>x.ID===id);if(!e)return;
  if(!await ask({tone:'danger',icon:'trash3-fill',title:'Hapus catatan ini?',text:'Catatan <b>'+esc(e.Kebiasaan)+'</b> tanggal '+fmtD(e.Tanggal)+' akan dihapus.',extra:'Catatan yang sudah dihapus tidak bisa dikembalikan.',ok:'Ya, hapus'}))return;
  run(null,async()=>{S.entries=await api('siswaHapusJurnal',id,S.profile.Nama,S.profile.Kelas);renderList();renderMsgs();toast('Catatan dihapus')},'Menghapus catatan...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')}

/* ===== GURU ===== */
const T={token:null,nama:'',entries:[],siswa:[]};
$('loginForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{const r=await api('guruLogin',$('l_u').value.trim(),$('l_p').value);
  T.token=r.token;T.nama=r.nama;$('l_p').value='';$('l_p').type='password';$('eyeIc').className='bi bi-eye-slash';await load();go('vGuru');toast('Selamat datang, '+r.nama)},'Sedang masuk...','Memeriksa akun dan memuat data siswa')};
function togglePw(){const i=$('l_p'),show=i.type==='password';i.type=show?'text':'password';$('eyeIc').className='bi '+(show?'bi-eye':'bi-eye-slash')}
async function logout(){
  if(!await ask({tone:'warn',icon:'box-arrow-right',title:'Keluar dari dashboard?',text:'Kamu perlu masuk lagi untuk membuka dashboard guru.',ok:'Ya, keluar'}))return;
  api('guruKeluar',T.token).catch(()=>{});T.token=null;go('vHome');toast('Kamu sudah keluar')}
async function load(){const d=await api('guruData',T.token);T.entries=d.entries;T.siswa=d.siswa;initF();renderT();renderSiswa()}
function setData(d){T.entries=d.entries;T.siswa=d.siswa;initF();renderT();renderSiswa()}
function initF(){const k=$('f_kelas').value,kb=$('f_kebiasaan').value;
  const kelas=[...new Set([...T.siswa.map(s=>s.Kelas),...T.entries.map(e=>e.Kelas)])].sort();
  $('f_kelas').innerHTML='<option value="">Semua</option>'+kelas.map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');$('f_kelas').value=k;
  $('f_kebiasaan').innerHTML='<option value="">Semua</option>'+Object.keys(H).map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('');$('f_kebiasaan').value=kb;
  if(!$('f_bulan').value&&!$('f_bulan').dataset.set){$('f_bulan').value=today().slice(0,7);$('f_bulan').dataset.set=1}
  const ks=$('fs_kelas').value;$('fs_kelas').innerHTML='<option value="">Semua kelas</option>'+[...new Set(T.siswa.map(s=>s.Kelas))].sort().map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');$('fs_kelas').value=ks;
  $('dlNama').innerHTML=T.siswa.map(s=>`<option value="${esc(s.Nama)}">${esc(s.Kelas)}</option>`).join('')}
function resetF(){['f_bulan','f_kelas','f_kebiasaan','f_status','f_cari'].forEach(i=>$(i).value='');renderT()}
function filtered(){const b=$('f_bulan').value,k=$('f_kelas').value,h=$('f_kebiasaan').value,s=$('f_status').value,q=$('f_cari').value.toLowerCase();
  return T.entries.filter(e=>(!b||e.Tanggal.startsWith(b))&&(!k||e.Kelas===k)&&(!h||e.Kebiasaan===h)&&(!s||e.Status===s)&&(!q||e.Nama.toLowerCase().includes(q)))}
function renderT(){const l=filtered(),all=T.entries,c=s=>all.filter(e=>e.Status===s).length;
  $('stats').innerHTML=[['Seluruh catatan',all.length,'#0b6bcb'],['Menunggu diperiksa',c('Menunggu'),'#e0a100'],['Sudah valid',c('Valid'),'#2fb36d'],['Perlu perbaikan',c('Perlu Perbaikan'),'#ff6b57'],['Jumlah siswa',T.siswa.length,'#7048e8']]
    .map(([t,n,col])=>`<div class="col-6 col-md"><div class="stat" style="background:${col}"><b>${n}</b>${t}</div></div>`).join('');
  $('cnt').textContent='('+l.length+')';
  $('tBody').innerHTML=l.length?l.map(e=>`<tr><td class="text-nowrap">${fmtD(e.Tanggal)}</td><td><b>${esc(e.Nama)}</b><div class="small text-muted">Kelas ${esc(e.Kelas)}</div></td><td>${chipHabit(e.Kebiasaan)}</td>
    <td class="small">${detail(e)}${e.KomentarGuru?`<div class="note mt-1"><i class="bi bi-chat-left-text me-1"></i>${esc(e.KomentarGuru)}</div>`:''}</td><td>${badge(e.Status)}</td>
    <td class="text-end text-nowrap"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-success" title="Tandai valid" onclick="quickOk('${e.ID}')"><i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i></button>
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" title="Komentar" onclick="openRev('${e.ID}')"><i class="bi bi-chat-dots"></i></button>
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light" title="Ubah" onclick="openEntry('${e.ID}')"><i class="bi bi-pencil"></i></button>
    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-danger" title="Hapus" onclick="delT('${e.ID}')"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button></td></tr>`).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty"><i class="bi bi-inbox"></i>Tidak ada catatan yang cocok dengan filter.</div></td></tr>'}
function filteredSiswa(){const k=$('fs_kelas').value,q=$('fs_cari').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return T.siswa.filter(s=>(!k||s.Kelas===k)&&(!q||[s.Nama,s.NamaOrtu,s.Alamat,s.Hobi].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)))}
function resetS(){$('fs_cari').value='';$('fs_kelas').value='';renderSiswa()}
function renderSiswa(){const n={},l=filteredSiswa();T.entries.forEach(e=>n[e.SiswaID]=(n[e.SiswaID]||0)+1);
  $('cntS').textContent=l.length===T.siswa.length?'('+l.length+')':'('+l.length+' dari '+T.siswa.length+')';
  $('sBody').innerHTML=l.length?l.map(s=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(s.Nama)}</b></td><td>${esc(s.Kelas)}</td><td>${s.TglLahir?fmtD(s.TglLahir):'-'}</td><td class="small">${esc(s.Alamat)||'-'}<div class="text-muted">Hobi: ${esc(s.Hobi)||'-'}</div></td>
    <td class="small">Tidur ${esc(s.JamTidur)||'-'}<br>Bangun ${esc(s.JamBangun)||'-'}<br>${esc(s.Agama)||''} ${esc(s.JamIbadah)}</td><td class="small">${esc(s.NamaOrtu)||'-'}</td><td>${n[s.SiswaID]||0}</td>
    <td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-danger" title="Hapus siswa" data-id="${esc(s.SiswaID)}" onclick="delSiswa(this.dataset.id)"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button></td></tr>`).join('')
    :`<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty"><i class="bi bi-${T.siswa.length?'search':'people'}"></i>${T.siswa.length?'Tidak ada siswa yang cocok dengan pencarian.':'Belum ada siswa yang mengisi.'}</div></td></tr>`}
const find=id=>T.entries.find(e=>e.ID===id);
const ringkas=e=>'<b>'+esc(e.Nama)+'</b> (kelas '+esc(e.Kelas)+')<br>'+esc(e.Kebiasaan)+' - '+fmtD(e.Tanggal);
async function quickOk(id){const e=find(id);if(!e)return;
  if(!await ask({tone:'ok',icon:'patch-check-fill',title:'Tandai sebagai valid?',text:'Catatan berikut akan ditandai valid.',extra:ringkas(e),ok:'Ya, validasi'}))return;
  run(null,async()=>{setData(await api('guruValidasi',T.token,id,'Valid',e.KomentarGuru));toast('Ditandai valid')},'Menyimpan validasi...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')}
async function delT(id){const e=find(id);if(!e)return;
  if(!await ask({tone:'danger',icon:'trash3-fill',title:'Hapus catatan ini?',text:'Catatan akan dihapus permanen dari database.',extra:ringkas(e),ok:'Ya, hapus'}))return;
  run(null,async()=>{setData(await api('guruHapusJurnal',T.token,id));toast('Catatan dihapus')},'Menghapus catatan...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')}
async function delSiswa(id){const s=T.siswa.find(x=>x.SiswaID===id);if(!s)return;const n=T.entries.filter(e=>e.SiswaID===id).length;
  if(!await ask({tone:'danger',icon:'person-x-fill',title:'Hapus data siswa?',text:'<b>'+esc(s.Nama)+'</b> (kelas '+esc(s.Kelas)+') akan dihapus dari database.',extra:'<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill text-danger me-1"></i>'+n+' catatan jurnal milik siswa ini ikut terhapus. Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.',ok:'Ya, hapus siswa'}))return;
  run(null,async()=>{setData(await api('guruHapusSiswa',T.token,id));toast('Siswa dihapus')},'Menghapus data siswa...','Menghapus siswa dan seluruh catatannya')}

/* Modal ubah/tambah */
let editId=null;const mE=new bootstrap.Modal($('mEntry')),mR=new bootstrap.Modal($('mRev'));
$('t_Kebiasaan').innerHTML=Object.keys(H).map(h=>`<option>${h}</option>`).join('');
function tFields(v={}){const h=$('t_Kebiasaan').value;$('tFields').innerHTML=fieldsHTML(h,'t_',v);if(h==='Beribadah')updDl('t_')}
function openEntry(id){editId=id||null;const e=id?find(id):{Tanggal:today()};
  $('mEntryT').textContent=id?'Ubah catatan siswa':'Tambah catatan siswa';
  $('t_Nama').value=e.Nama||'';$('t_Kelas').value=e.Kelas||'';$('t_Tanggal').value=e.Tanggal;$('t_Kebiasaan').value=e.Kebiasaan||'Bangun Pagi';tFields(e);mE.show()}
$('t_Nama').onchange=()=>{const s=T.siswa.find(x=>x.Nama===$('t_Nama').value);if(s&&!$('t_Kelas').value)$('t_Kelas').value=s.Kelas};
$('tForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();const h=$('t_Kebiasaan').value;
  const e={ID:editId,Nama:$('t_Nama').value,Kelas:$('t_Kelas').value,Kebiasaan:h,Tanggal:$('t_Tanggal').value,...getVals(h,'t_')};
  if(h==='Beribadah'&&document.querySelector('#tFields .ibt.is-invalid')){toast('Ada jam yang formatnya salah, contoh yang benar 04.30',true);return}
  if(h==='Beribadah'&&!e.Detail2){toast('Isi minimal satu ibadah beserta jamnya',true);return}
  run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{setData(await api('guruSimpanJurnal',T.token,e));mE.hide();toast(editId?'Perubahan tersimpan':'Catatan ditambahkan')},'Menyimpan catatan...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')};
let revId=null;
function openRev(id){revId=id;const e=find(id);$('rInfo').innerHTML=`<b>${esc(e.Nama)}</b> (${esc(e.Kelas)}) - ${esc(e.Kebiasaan)}<div class="small">${fmtD(e.Tanggal)}</div>${detail(e)}`;
  $('r_Status').value=e.Status==='Menunggu'?'Valid':e.Status;$('r_Komentar').value=e.KomentarGuru||'';mR.show()}
$('rForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{setData(await api('guruValidasi',T.token,revId,$('r_Status').value,$('r_Komentar').value));mR.hide();toast('Penilaian tersimpan, siswa dapat melihat komentarmu')},'Menyimpan penilaian...','Mohon tunggu sebentar')};

/* Modal tambah akun guru */
const mAk=new bootstrap.Modal($('mAkun'));
function openAkun(){$('aForm').reset();['a_P','a_P2'].forEach(i=>$(i).type='password');$('eyeAk').className='bi bi-eye-slash';mAk.show()}
function togglePwAkun(){const show=$('a_P').type==='password';['a_P','a_P2'].forEach(i=>$(i).type=show?'text':'password');$('eyeAk').className='bi '+(show?'bi-eye':'bi-eye-slash')}
$('aForm').onsubmit=ev=>{ev.preventDefault();const u=$('a_User').value.trim(),n=$('a_Nama').value.trim(),p=$('a_P').value;
  if(p!==$('a_P2').value){toast('Ulangi sandi belum sama',true);return}
  run(sbtn(ev),async()=>{await api('guruTambahAkun',T.token,n,u,p);mAk.hide();toast('Akun "'+u+'" dibuat. Sudah bisa dipakai untuk masuk.')},'Membuat akun guru...','Menyimpan ke spreadsheet')};
</script>
</body>
</html>
